arxiv-1805-07605.creator: Zhengheng Li, Merlin Kole, Jianchao Sun, Liming Song, Nicolas Produit, Bobing Wu, Tianwei Bao, Tancredi Bernasconi, Franck Cadoux, Yongwei Dong, Minzi Feng, Neal Gauvin, Wojtek Hajdas, Hancheng Li, Lu Li, Xin Liu, Radoslaw Marcinkowski, Martin Pohl, Dominik K. Rybka, Haoli Shi, Jacek Szabelski, Tere
arxiv-1805-07605.description: Abstract POLAR is a compact space-borne detector designed to perform reliable measurements of the polarization for transient sources like Gamma-Ray Bursts in the energy range 50–500 keV. The instrument works based on the Compton Scattering principle with the plastic scintillators as the main detection material along with the multi-anode photomultiplier tube.

arxiv-2302-12642.title: The Mellin Transform and Non-local Derivatives of Fractal Calculus
arxiv-2302-12642.creator: Alireza Khalili Golmankhaneh
arxiv-2302-12642.description: Abstract In this paper, the fractal calculus of fractal sets and fractal curves are compared. The analogues of the Riemann-Liouville and the Caputo integrals and derivatives are defined for the fractal curves which are non-local derivatives. The analogous for the fractional Laplace concepts are defined to solve fractal non-local differential equations on fractal curves.

arxiv-2303-01517.title: An adaptive Bayesian quantum algorithm for phase estimation
arxiv-2303-01517.creator: Joseph G. Smith, Crispin H. W. Barnes, David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur
arxiv-2303-01517.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Joseph G. Smith, Crispin H. W. Barnes, David R. M. Arvidsson-Shukur. Quantum-phase-estimation algorithms are critical subroutines in many applications for quantum computers and in quantum-metrology protocols. These algorithms estimate the unknown strength of a unitary evolution.

arxiv-2310-04187.title: Whole Slide Multiple Instance Learning for Predicting Axillary Lymph Node Metastasis
arxiv-2310-04187.creator: Glejdis Shkëmbi, Johanna P. Müller, Zhe Li, Katharina Breininger, Peter Schüffler, Bernhard Kainz
arxiv-2310-04187.description: Abstract Breast cancer is a major concern for women’s health globally, with axillary lymph node (ALN) metastasis identification being critical for prognosis evaluation and treatment guidance. This paper presents a deep learning (DL) classification pipeline for quantifying clinical information from digital core-needle biopsy (CNB) images, with one step less than existing methods.

arxiv-2504-00964.title: Random cliques in random graphs revisited
arxiv-2504-00964.creator: Robert Morris, and Oliver Riordan
arxiv-2504-00964.description: Abstract We study the distribution of the set of copies of some given graph H H in the random graph G ⁡ ( n , p ) G(n,p) , focusing on the case when H = K r H=K_{r} .

arxiv-2509-26165.title: Human-MME: A Holistic Evaluation Benchmark for Human-Centric Multimodal Large Language Models
arxiv-2509-26165.creator: Yuansen Liu 1 , Haiming Tang 1 , Jinlong Peng 2 , Jiangning Zhang 2 , Xiaozhong Ji 3 , Qingdong He 2 , Donghao Luo 2 , Zhenye Gan 2 , Junwei Zhu 2 , Yunhang Shen 2 , Chaoyou Fu 3 , Chengjie Wang 2 , Xiaobin Hu 1 , Shuicheng Yan 1 1 National University of Singapore 2 Tencent Youtu Lab 3 Nanjing Unive
arxiv-2509-26165.description: Abstract Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant advances in visual understanding tasks. However, their capacity to comprehend human-centric scenes has rarely been explored, primarily due to the absence of comprehensive evaluation benchmarks that take into account both the human-oriented granular level and higher-dimensional causal reasoning ability.

arxiv-2601-12169.title: Learning Legged MPC with Smooth Neural Surrogates
arxiv-2601-12169.creator: Samuel A. Moore, Easop Lee, Boyuan Chen
arxiv-2601-12169.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Samuel A. Moore, Easop Lee, Boyuan Chen. Deep learning and model predictive control (MPC) can play complementary roles in legged robotics. However, integrating learned models with online planning remains challenging. When dynamics are learned with neural networks, three key difficulties arise: (1) stiff transitions from contact events may be inherited from the data; (2) additional non-physical local nonsmoothness can occur; and (3) training datasets can induce non-Gaussian model errors due to rapid state changes.

pmc-10572967.title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Dynamic and Rapid Transcriptional Reprogramming Involved in Heat Stress and Identification of Heat Response Genes in Rice
pmc-10572967.creator: Yonggang He, Huimin Guan, Bo Li, Shuo Zhang, Yanhao Xu, Yan Yao, Xiaolong Yang, Zhongping Zha, Ying Guo, Chunhai Jiao, Haiya Cai
pmc-10572967.description: High temperature is one of the most important environmental factors influencing rice growth, development, and yield. Therefore, it is important to understand how rice plants cope with high temperatures. Herein, the heat tolerances of T2 (Jinxibai) and T21 (Taizhongxianxuan2hao) were evaluated at 45 °C, and T21 was found to be sensitive to heat stress at the seedling stage.

pmc-10747554.title: Prophylactic Vaccination and Intratumoral Boost with HER2-Expressing Oncolytic Herpes Simplex Virus Induces Robust and Persistent Immune Response against HER2-Positive Tumor Cells
pmc-10747554.creator: Zahid Delwar, Olga Tatsiy, Dmitry V. Chouljenko, I-Fang Lee, Guoyu Liu, Xiaohu Liu, Luke Bu, Jun Ding, Manu Singh, Yanal M. Murad, William Wei-Guo Jia
pmc-10747554.description: The development of effective cancer vaccines remains a significant challenge due to immune tolerance and limited clinical benefits. Oncolytic herpes simplex virus type 1 (oHSV-1) has shown promise as a cancer therapy, but efficacy is often limited in advanced cancers.

Those could play a role in first ray destabilization and misalignment in HV.

pmc-11512380.title: Molecular Detection by Rolling Circle Amplification Combined with Deep Sequencing of Mixed Infection by Bovine Papillomaviruses 2 and 4 in Carcinoma In Situ of the Bovine Esophageal Mucosa
pmc-11512380.creator: Bruna F Matias, Michele Lunardi, Kátia C B Gonçalves, Laurival A Vilas-Boas, Emanuele Gustani-Buss, Ana Paula F R L Bracarense, Luiz Fernando C Cunha Filho, Alice F Alfieri, Amauri A Alfieri, Ronald N Harty
pmc-11512380.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Papillomaviruses (PVs) are oncogenic and infect the skin and mucosa of various host species. Considering the recent advances in research on PVs using rolling circle amplification (RCA) followed by high-throughput sequencing (HTS), in this study, we aimed to investigate the bovine papillomavirus (BPV) types associated with proliferative lesions in the upper alimentary tract of an affected bull and characterize the viral strains through complete genome sequencing using this strategy.

pmc-11538533.title: Unveiling the culinary tradition of ‘focaccia’ in Late Neolithic Mesopotamia by way of the integration of use-wear, phytolith & organic-residue analyses
pmc-11538533.creator: Sergio Taranto, Adrià Breu Barcons, Marta Portillo, Marie Le Miere, Anna Bach Gomèz, Miquel Molist, Cristina Lemorini
pmc-11538533.description: Recent studies suggest that in Upper Mesopotamia during the Late Neolithic period, specifically between 6400 and 5900 BCE, simple cereal flour doughs were baked in domed ovens using ceramic pans, commonly known as husking trays. Adopting an integrated approach that investigates various types of evidence, such as use-wear, phytoliths, and organic residues, we further refined and explored this hypothesis.

pmc-12453242.title: Speech-in-noise discriminability after noise exposure: Insights from a gerbil model of acoustic trauma
pmc-12453242.creator: Carolin Jüchter, Rainer Beutelmann, Sonny Bovee, Katja Bleckmann, Georg Martin Klump, Andreas Buechner, Andreas Buechner, Andreas Buechner
pmc-12453242.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Speech comprehension, especially in the presence of background sounds, allegedly declines as a consequence of noise-induced hearing loss. However, the connection between noise overexposure and deteriorated speech-in-noise perception despite normal audiometric thresholds (hidden hearing loss) is not yet clear. This study investigates speech-in-noise discrimination in young-adult Mongolian gerbils before and after an acoustic trauma to examine the link between noise exposure and speech-in-noise perception.

pmc-13146956.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A970 EARLY (<48 HOURS) VERSUS DELAYED (2–14 DAYS) CAROTID ANGIOPLASTY AND STENTING IN SYMPTOMATIC CAROTID ARTERY STENOSIS: AN ARGENTINIAN SINGLE CENTER EXPERIENCE
pmc-13146956.creator: Manuel Ignacio Chasco, Julieta Rosales, Juan José Cirio, Julieta Russo, Matias Lopez, Nicolas Perez, Laura Caballero, Esteban Scrivano, Ivan Lylyk, Lylyk Pedro
pmc-13146956.description: Background and aimsOptimal timing of carotid revascularization with percutaneous transluminal angioplasty and stenting (PTAS) after acute ischemic stroke (AIS) due to symptomatic carotid stenosis (SCS) remains uncertain. This study aimed to compare the safety and efficacy of early versus delayed PTAS following symptom onset.

pmc-13188086.title: Closed reduction of acute posterior shoulder dislocation via intra-articular anesthesia: a case report and technical note
pmc-13188086.creator: Andrea Redler, Alessandro Maggiori, Vito Caiolo, Cristiano Benelli, Damiano Caruso, Raffaele Iorio, Nicola Maffulli
pmc-13188086.description: PSDs may also result from electric shocks or seizures due to imbalanced muscle contraction. This occurs when the internal rotator muscles contract with greater force than the external rotators, causing the humeral head to move superiorly and posteriorly.1 Acute PSDs are often missed in up to 50% of cases despite typical clinical and radiographic signs.

pmc-13556434.title: 867. The COMB-study on varenicline and bupropion for alcohol use disorder: effects of/on WHO drinking risk levels, sex, self-reported heredity and nicotine use
pmc-13556434.creator: B Söderpalm, H Lidö, J Franck, A Håkansson, D Lindqvist, M Heilig, J Guterstam, M Samuelson, B Askerup, C Wallmark-Nilsson, A de Bejczy
pmc-13556434.description: BackgroundAlcohol Use Disorder (AUD) afflicts 100 million people, causes 3 million deaths/year and generates enormous costs. Available treatments have limited effects. The dopamine deficiency hypothesis of AUD posits that ethanol intake is driven by negative reinforcement generated by a low dopamine state in the brain.

pmc-13578360.title: Multiplexed catheter-integrated pressure sensing system for endoluminal interventions
pmc-13578360.creator: Xiaotong Guo, Qindong Zheng, Jinshi Zhao, Bing Li, Eric M. Yeatman
pmc-13578360.description: Advances in flexible catheters pave the way for minimally invasive diagnosis and treatment of luminal organs and tubular structures through endoluminal interventions. A key challenge is in establishing non-constraining pressure monitoring at the interfaces between medical catheters and intraluminal anatomy, where catheter–tissue interactions may be influenced by lumen curvature, structural variability, and physiological motion.
